session_note: Kansas runs a 2025-2026 biennium; bills introduced in 2025 remain live through the 2026 session and die only at the end of the biennium or on their own 'Died' calendar/committee action. The prior 2023-2024 biennium (HB 2450, SB 545 in this packet) already concluded, with both bills recorded 'Died on Calendar' on 2024-04-30. Within the current 2025-2026 biennium, several 2026 Senate bills in this packet (SB 400, SB 526, SB 531) were recorded 'Died in Committee' on 2026-04-10, while others continued through conference committee and governor action into late April 2026 (SB 51 signed 2026-04-27; a related large-load ratepayer bill, SB 92, signed 2026-04-09).
